note: Two readings of conformance/toml_misread.toml. Every construct in that file is valid TOML 1.0 that gnomon's parser accepts and reads as a DIFFERENT value -- no error, no warning, no startup failure. 'gnomon' is what parseToml returns and is asserted by packages/gnomon-core/src/config.test.ts. 'toml' is what a spec parser returns: Python 3.12 tomllib, recorded offline on 2026-09-01. Nothing in CI re-runs the tomllib half -- CI has no Python and the harness has no TOML library -- so an edit to the fixture must be re-checked by hand. Recording gnomon's reading here is documentation of a limit, not endorsement of it. One caveat about reading the two halves side by side: the 'toml' half is JSON-serialised, so a TOML date renders as the same characters gnomon produces and a text diff shows no difference for `date` and `datetime`. The divergence there is the TYPE -- a date object under a spec parser, a string here -- which is why config.test.ts asserts the type rather than eyeballing the diff.
